messages.subject: Revolution R Open and Shiny-Server
parts:
Hello,

Recently I spent a few days trying to figure out the source of an error that occurred any time I attempted to access a shiny application being served on a local Ubuntu server (14.04). It was a javascript error box that popped up and crashed the application at launch each time, but the console displayed what looked like an R error message. I was never able to replicate that error from RStudio-server, or on any of my local installations (including my laptop which has Revolution R Open installed). After a while, I reinstalled R from CRAN on the server and immediately had no further issues with things. I was wondering if this happened with anyone else and/or if this was a known bug. The server is running on an x86_64 architecture. Given what appeared to be some fairly substantial performance gains (I'm not a system admin, but suppose I could probably work something out to monitor/test performance differences), I wanted to try resolving things and using Revolution R Open as the backend version of R. I have an academic license for Revolution R Enterprise, but had already installed it on my personal desktop else I would attempt testing things with that as well.
